item.title: Some Ideas for a MemoryFS Storage System
item.description: 1. Using Memory as a Storage Medium The image above is the storage pyramid, showing the relationship between the price of a storage medium and its speed. Today, enterprises widely adopt tape and disks as storage media mainly because of their price advantage. Market prices are driven by supply and demand: even for an expensive storage medium, if the production cost is low, the market is large enough, and the yield rate in the production process is high, its market price will come down.
